# Prepare the FASTQ dataset

## Download the FASTQ files

The worked example uses ten paired-end RNA-seq samples from PRJNA1161405: Normal1-Normal5 and HCC1-HCC5.

Download the FASTQ files from ENA:

```bash
mkdir -p data/fastq

wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/060/SRR35344560/SRR35344560_1.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344560_Normal1_1.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/060/SRR35344560/SRR35344560_2.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344560_Normal1_2.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/061/SRR35344561/SRR35344561_1.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344561_Normal2_1.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/061/SRR35344561/SRR35344561_2.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344561_Normal2_2.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/062/SRR35344562/SRR35344562_1.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344562_Normal3_1.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/062/SRR35344562/SRR35344562_2.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344562_Normal3_2.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/063/SRR35344563/SRR35344563_1.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344563_Normal4_1.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/063/SRR35344563/SRR35344563_2.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344563_Normal4_2.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/064/SRR35344564/SRR35344564_1.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344564_Normal5_1.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/064/SRR35344564/SRR35344564_2.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344564_Normal5_2.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/066/SRR35344566/SRR35344566_1.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344566_HCC1_1.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/066/SRR35344566/SRR35344566_2.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344566_HCC1_2.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/067/SRR35344567/SRR35344567_1.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344567_HCC2_1.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/067/SRR35344567/SRR35344567_2.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344567_HCC2_2.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/068/SRR35344568/SRR35344568_1.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344568_HCC3_1.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/068/SRR35344568/SRR35344568_2.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344568_HCC3_2.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/069/SRR35344569/SRR35344569_1.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344569_HCC4_1.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/069/SRR35344569/SRR35344569_2.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344569_HCC4_2.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/070/SRR35344570/SRR35344570_1.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344570_HCC5_1.fastq.gz
wget -c https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR353/070/SRR35344570/SRR35344570_2.fastq.gz -O data/fastq/SRR35344570_HCC5_2.fastq.gz
```

The output directory contains:

```text
data/fastq/
├── SRR35344560_Normal1_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344560_Normal1_2.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344561_Normal2_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344561_Normal2_2.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344562_Normal3_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344562_Normal3_2.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344563_Normal4_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344563_Normal4_2.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344564_Normal5_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344564_Normal5_2.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344566_HCC1_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344566_HCC1_2.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344567_HCC2_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344567_HCC2_2.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344568_HCC3_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR35344568_HCC3_2.fastq.gz

├── SRR35344569_HCC4_2.fastq.gz

└── SRR35344570_HCC5_2.fastq.gz
```

## Check the FASTQ files

```bash
test "$(find data/fastq -maxdepth 1 -name '*.fastq.gz' | wc -l)" -eq 20
gzip -t data/fastq/*.fastq.gz
echo "All twenty FASTQ files passed the gzip integrity check."
```

Data source: [NCBI BioProject PRJNA1161405](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/PRJNA1161405).
